dict.string: Search and edit gopass entries in Alfred 6

## Usage
Type `gp` to browse the store or `gp search terms` to open a filtered list.
| Shortcut | Action | | --- | --- | | Enter | Copy the password using gopass's timed clipboard | | Command + Enter | Open the selected entry's editor | | Shift + Enter | Copy the username | | Control + Enter | Open the stored HTTP(S) website | | Command + K | Open the actions menu | | Command + F | Focus search |
The window opens with focus on the results. After typing into the search field, use Down Arrow to return to the results before pressing Shift + Enter. The actions menu also contains Copy Username.
The edit sheet supports username, website, and a replacement password. Leave the password blank to retain the current one. Command + S saves, and Escape cancels. The editor operates on conventional gopass entries with the password on the first line and `username:` (or `user:` / `login:`) and `url:` (or `website:`) fields on subsequent lines. Other entry content is preserved.
